text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins today! Fine 
Motion has been eagerly looking forward to 
this day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dragging along an irritated Air Shakur, 
who was frustrated with not getting the 
results she wanted, she threw herself into 
enjoying the summer training camp to the 
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the watchful gaze of the Royal 
Guard, Fine Motion focused on honing her 
skills for the Shuka Sho!
